name: Croatian Quiet Championship 2026

venue.name: Microsoft Hrvatska
venue.details: Natjecanje će biti održano na 6. katu zgrade. / Competition will be held at the 6th floor.

information:
(HR)

Croatian Quiet Championship 2026 je natjecanje koje se održava u Zagrebu. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost. Preporučujemo da budete upoznati s WCA Pravilnikom.

Budući da se FMC i discipline slaganja naslijepo ne nalaze na [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), ovo je Vaša prilika da postanete Hrvatski prvak u tim disciplinama.

Nagrade za najbolja 3 hrvata će biti dodijeljene na svečanoj ceremoniji u Petrinji tjedan dana kasnije.

*Ne morate se natjecati na Croatian Championshipu kako bi ste se natjecali na ovom natjecanju.*

Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja.

**NAPOMENA - NA OVOM NATJECANJU SE NEĆE ODRŽATI KLASIČNE DISCIPLINE KAO NPR. 3X3X3 KOCKA**

(EN)

Croatian Quiet Championship 2026 is a competition that will take place in Zagreb. Anyone may participate, regardless of nationality or age. We recommend that all competitors become familiar with the WCA Regulations.

Since FMC and blindfolded events will not be held at [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), this is your chance to become the Croatian champion in those events.

Awards for the top 3 Croatian competitors will be presented at the ceremony in Petrinja one week later.

*You do not have to compete at Croatian Championship to take part in this competition.*

For more information, please check the other tabs on the competition page.

**NOTE: THIS COMPETITION WILL NOT INCLUDE REGULAR EVENTS SUCH AS THE 3X3X3 CUBE.**
